worldcombat.skill.vitalthrow.summary: Brace for a nearby foe, then fling it along its momentum. A target caught mid-action takes a stronger throw. A successful launch followed by a prompt landing adds a pin; knockback resistance and terrain govern the actual flight.
worldcombat.skill.vitalthrow.description: The throw deals about %1$s damage; when the target is mid-action (borrowed momentum) its power rises by %2$s. Defence, type matchups and crit are settled on the hit.
The user braces for %1$s s before striking, grabbing a target within %2$s blocks; with nothing to grab nearby the move whiffs.

Add %1$s blocks/tick along the target’s horizontal momentum, or away from the user if it is still. Resistance and terrain determine the actual movement. A successful launch followed by a prompt landing pins the target for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.vitalthrow.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.vitalthrow.growth.0: At level %1$s: throw power %2$s and pin %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.vitalthrow.growth.1: At level %1$s: throw power %2$s and added throw velocity %3$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.vitalthrow.use.1: Fling a charging foe along its own momentum
worldcombat.skill.vitalthrow.use.2: Out-wrestle a high-Defence target with raw mass
On: the stance waits 4 ticks longer, grab range about +15%%, momentum bonus about x1.3 and cooldown 6 ticks longer, built to catch a charge. Off: a quick grab-and-toss, shorter stance, shorter reach and smaller bonus, for a foe already on top of you.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of bracing. Larger values let it set up earlier and wait for the charge.
On: a foe pressing toward the user is preferred, which is where the borrowed momentum pays; off: any nearby foe is treated the same.
On: the user may leave its post to get close; off: it only throws from where it stands.
